calibration_grid: exact saved original-training Ridge SKU/origin/horizon grid
residual_definition: actual_sales - point_prediction; opposite sign to signed-bias metric
weekday_pooling: all target weekdays pooled within each SKU/horizon-week group
missing_group_policy: explicit missing status and counts, no substitution; affected aggregate coverage/width/score undefined
validation_points: unchanged saved weekday_mean predictions; 28000 per level
interpretation: empirical historical-error daily prediction intervals; development evidence, no conformal or finite-sample guarantees
aggregate_uncertainty: not estimated; never sum daily bounds and call them calibrated total-sales intervals
plot_selection: same original training-volume ranks 1,50,100; SKU tie ascending; origin 2011-08-08
